title: Avista Corp. Board Declares Common Stock Dividend
summary: SPOKANE, Wash., Nov. 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Avista Corp.’s (NYSE: AVA) board of directors has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.4925 per share on the company’s common stock, yielding an annualized dividend of $1.97.
